name: A Grave Situation
label: Quest
description: A Grave Situation: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you return to the graveyard, friend, you will find a gravestone there... Not just any gravestone; this one will stand out from the others. Secrets lie within it.
Push on the stone, and you will learn of these secrets...

clips.title: Progress
paras: This must be the gravestone that Gaeriyan mentioned...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You push on the stone firmly, and it slides away, revealing a small depression underneath it.
Placing Linken's Sword into the depression, you realize that it fits perfectly...
